findings.title: Much of the module time has no cost model
findings.evidence: 2418 of 7138 ms is in modules the cost model does not know

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn1 (up)
findings.evidence: 204.5 ms per step against an ideal 6.0 ms (3% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 4510 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn2 (up)
findings.evidence: 192.1 ms per step against an ideal 6.0 ms (3% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 4510 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Dtype and copy kernels take a large share
findings.evidence: 25% of device time is casts and copies
findings.lever: find the modules issuing `.to(dtype)` round trips (autocast boundaries, adapter branches) and keep one dtype through them

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn1 (down)
findings.evidence: 169.4 ms per step against an ideal 4.0 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 24 layers; all rated pieces together leave 4510 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: linear attn1.to_q (up)
findings.evidence: 160.7 ms per step against an ideal 2.6 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 4510 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn2 (down)
findings.evidence: 161.1 ms per step against an ideal 4.0 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 24 layers; all rated pieces together leave 4510 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Many small memory-bound kernels
findings.evidence: 46% of device time (16088 calls per step) is elementwise, normalisation, copy, memory and reduction work
findings.lever: fusion (fewer, larger kernels): norm + modulation, activation + multiply, cast + matmul input; half the time is the most a fusion usually recovers

findings.title: Some steps in the window were much slower than the rest
findings.evidence: 1 step(s) took over twice the median: step 20 (2, 68, 92) 5280 ms
findings.lever: a latent shape seen for the first time costs kernel and primitive creation (seconds); fewer distinct shapes (buckets.max_shapes) and a longer warm-up

findings.title: Module times do not add up to the device time
findings.evidence: modules account for 7138 ms of 669 ms device time per eager step
findings.lever: the difference is work outside the hooked modules (loss, optimizer, data movement) or host waits; see the phase and category tables
